At 480 it holds eight, five of them on torn sheets, five distinct. The phone's width is where the five clips are shot and is what found the truncations and the wrong module row costs this cycle — those fixes all stay — but the still that the material row is judged on at three hundred per cent has to hold what the brief asks it to hold.
